description: Cambridgeshire County Council Traffic Count Data is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Cambridgeshire Insight. "Traffic Counts" data refers to the number of vehicles counted at predetermined specific points across the county. It is collated annually by the Data Analysis and Performance team, using video surveys, and is summarised by vehicle type. Coverage: Cambridgeshire Insight. The portal files it under the publisher Cambridgeshire Insight. Its tags are Traffic, transport. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2025-04-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
